subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context (a single academic school spanning sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength & conditioning). There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge and draws worked examples from across these subjects rather than one discipline.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for reflective-practice-advanced. Frames the academic-practice skill for the school as a whole; worked examples vary across its subjects lesson to lesson (L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation).
